# HARBOUR

> > HARBOUR offers handcrafted luxury outdoor furniture featuring sustainable Indonesian teak, powder-coated aluminum, and premium marine-grade fabrics including Batyline, Panama, and Agora.

HARBOUR specializes in high-end outdoor furniture collections including Hayman, Breeze XL, Byron, Avalon, Amalfi, Moab, and MLB. All products are designed for durability with weather-resistant materials and custom-fit protective covers available in Surlast fabric.

## Key Topics

- Indonesian teak
- Powder-coated aluminum
- Batyline sling fabric
- Agora outdoor fabric
- Panama fabric
- Surlast weather covers
- Marine-grade materials
- Sustainable teak
- Hayman collection
- Breeze XL collection
- Byron collection
- Avalon collection
- Custom-fit furniture protection
- Luxury outdoor furniture
- AzkoNobel finishes
